messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The MPON reports the meter operation to the GO. The GO examines the application of the MPON. The GO rejects the application of the MPON or the GO confirmes the application of the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the registration confirmation of the MPON. The MPON and the MPOO perform the equipment acquisition and / or equipment changes. The MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process or the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the entire process. The GO informs the MPON about the failure of the overall transaction by deadline if after a maximum time limit no message of the MPON is present at the GO. If the MPON informs the GO about the failure of the entire process, the GO confirms the failure of the assignment to the MPON. If the MPON informs the GO about the successful completion of the overall process, the GO assigns the MPON. The GO confirms the assignment to the MPON. The GO informs the MPOO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MPOO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the MSPO about the failure of the assignment of the MPON or the GO informs the MSPO about the assignment of the MPON. The GO informs the SP about the assignment of the MPON.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"

             id="definitions_mpo_process"

    <messageFlow id="mf_report_meter_op" name="Meter Operation Application" sourceRef="task_report_meter_op" targetRef="start_go" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_reject_app" name="Application Rejection" sourceRef="task_reject_app" targetRef="event_app_rejected_mpon" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mpon" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_confirm_app" targetRef="task_perform_equip_mpon" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mpoo" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_inform_mpoo_reg" targetRef="task_perform_equip_mpoo" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_reg_mspo" name="Registration Confirmation" sourceRef="task_inform_mspo_reg" targetRef="event_mspo_reg_rcvd" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_failure" name="Process Failure Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_failure" targetRef="event_failure_msg_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_success" name="Process Success Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_success" targetRef="event_success_msg_rcvd" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_deadline_failure" name="Transaction Failure by Deadline" sourceRef="task_inform_mpon_deadline_failure" targetRef="event_mpon_deadline_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_failure_mpon" name="Assignment Failure Confirmation" sourceRef="task_confirm_failure_mpon" targetRef="event_mpon_failure_confirmed" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_confirm_assign_mpon" name="Assignment Confirmation" sourceRef="task_confirm_assign_mpon" targetRef="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" />
    
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_mpoo_fail" name="Assignment Failure Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_mpoo_fail" targetRef="event_mpoo_fail_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_mpoo_pass" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_mpoo_pass" targetRef="event_mpoo_pass_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_mspo_fail" name="Assignment Failure Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_mspo_fail" targetRef="event_mspo_fail_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_mspo_pass" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_mspo_pass" targetRef="event_mspo_pass_rcvd" />
    <messageFlow id="mf_inform_sp_pass" name="Assignment Notification" sourceRef="task_inform_sp" targetRef="event_sp_pass_rcvd" />
  </collaboration>

  <!-- MPON Process -->
  <process id="process_mpon" isExecutable="false">
    <startEvent id="start_mpon" name="Start">
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>
    <task id="task_report_meter_op" name="Report Meter Operation to GO">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_2</outgoing>
    </task>
    <eventBasedGateway id="evgw_mpon_1">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_2</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_3</outgoing>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_4</outgoing>
    </eventBasedGateway>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_app_rejected_mpon" name="Application Rejected">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_3</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_end_1</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_mpon_1" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <endEvent id="end_mpon_rejected" name="Process Terminated (Rejected)">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_end_1</incoming>
    </endEvent>
    
    <task id="task_perform_equip_mpon" name="Perform Equipment Acquisition / Changes">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_5</outgoing>
    </task>
    
    <exclusiveGateway id="gw_mpon_result" name="Equipment Process Result?">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_5</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_fail</outgoing>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_succ</outgoing>
    </exclusiveGateway>
    
    <task id="task_inform_failure" name="Inform GO about Failure of Process">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_fail</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_6</outgoing>
    </task>
    <eventBasedGateway id="evgw_mpon_fail_wait">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_6</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_7</outgoing>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_8</outgoing>
    </eventBasedGateway>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_mpon_failure_confirmed" name="Failure Confirmed by GO">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_7</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_end_2</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_mpon_2" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_mpon_deadline_rcvd" name="Transaction Deadline Failure Rcvd">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_8</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_end_3</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_mpon_3" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <endEvent id="end_mpon_failed" name="Process Ended (Failed)">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_end_2</incoming>
      <incoming>sf_mpon_end_3</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <task id="task_inform_success" name="Inform GO about Successful Completion">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_succ</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_9</outgoing>
    </task>
    <intermediateCatchEvent id="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" name="Assignment Confirmed by GO">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_9</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_mpon_end_4</outgoing>
      <messageEventDefinition id="med_mpon_4" />
    </intermediateCatchEvent>
    <endEvent id="end_mpon_assigned" name="Process Completed (Assigned)">
      <incoming>sf_mpon_end_4</incoming>
    </endEvent>

    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_1" sourceRef="start_mpon" targetRef="task_report_meter_op" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_2" sourceRef="task_report_meter_op" targetRef="evgw_mpon_1" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_3" sourceRef="evgw_mpon_1" targetRef="event_app_rejected_mpon" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_4" sourceRef="evgw_mpon_1" targetRef="task_perform_equip_mpon" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_end_1" sourceRef="event_app_rejected_mpon" targetRef="end_mpon_rejected" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_5" sourceRef="task_perform_equip_mpon" targetRef="gw_mpon_result" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_fail" name="Failure" sourceRef="gw_mpon_result" targetRef="task_inform_failure" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_succ" name="Success" sourceRef="gw_mpon_result" targetRef="task_inform_success" />

    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_7" sourceRef="evgw_mpon_fail_wait" targetRef="event_mpon_failure_confirmed" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_8" sourceRef="evgw_mpon_fail_wait" targetRef="event_mpon_deadline_rcvd" />

    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_end_3" sourceRef="event_mpon_deadline_rcvd" targetRef="end_mpon_failed" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_9" sourceRef="task_inform_success" targetRef="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" />
    <sequenceFlow id="sf_mpon_end_4" sourceRef="event_mpon_assign_confirmed" targetRef="end_mpon_assigned" />

    <task id="task_examine_app" name="Examine Application of MPON">
      <incoming>sf_go_1</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_2</outgoing>

    <exclusiveGateway id="gw_go_app_decision" name="Application Approved?">

    <task id="task_reject_app" name="Reject Application of MPON">

      <outgoing>sf_go_3</outgoing>
    </task>
    <endEvent id="end_go_rejected" name="Application Rejected">
      <incoming>sf_go_3</incoming>

    <task id="task_confirm_app" name="Confirm Application of MPON">
      <incoming>sf_go_confirm</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_4</outgoing>
    </task>
    <parallelGateway id="pgw_go_inform_reg">
      <incoming>sf_go_4</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_5</outgoing>

      <outgoing>sf_go_9</outgoing>

      <outgoing>sf_go_14</outgoing>

    <!-- Failure Merge -->
    <exclusiveGateway id="gw_go_failure_merge">
      <incoming>sf_go_13</incoming>
      <incoming>sf_go_14</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_15</outgoing>

    <parallelGateway id="pgw_go_inform_failure">
      <incoming>sf_go_15</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_16</outgoing>
      <outgoing>sf_go_17</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>
    <task id="task_inform_mpoo_fail" name="Inform MPOO about Failure of Assignment">
      <incoming>sf_go_16</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_18</outgoing>
    </task>
    <task id="task_inform_mspo_fail" name="Inform MSPO about Failure of Assignment">
      <incoming>sf_go_17</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_19</outgoing>
    </task>
    <parallelGateway id="pgw_go_inform_failure_join">
      <incoming>sf_go_18</incoming>
      <incoming>sf_go_19</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_20</outgoing>
    </parallelGateway>
    <endEvent id="end_go_failed" name="Overall Process Failed">
      <incoming>sf_go_20</incoming>

    <!-- Path 3: Success -->
    <task id="task_assign_mpon" name="Assign MPON">

    </task>

      <incoming>sf_go_21</incoming>

    <parallelGateway id="pgw_go_inform_success">
      <incoming>sf_go_22</incoming>
      <outgoing>sf_go_23</outgoing>

      <incoming>sf_go_24</incoming>

    </task>
    <task id="task_inform_sp" name="Inform SP about Assignment of MPON">
      <incoming>sf_go_25</incoming>

    <parallelGateway id="pgw_go_inform_success_join">

  <!-- MPOO Process -->
  <process id="process_mpoo" isExecutable="false">
    <startEvent id="start_mpoo" name="Start MPOO Monitoring">
      <outgoing>sf_mpoo_1</outgoing>
    </startEvent>
    <task id="task_perform_equip_mpoo" name="Perform Equipment Acquisition / Changes">
